content: 我司今年上半年的利润是多少
SELECT report_period, total_profit FROM income_sheet WHERE stock_abbr = 'YOUR_COMPANY' AND report_period LIKE '2024%' AND report_period LIKE '%06%' ORDER BY report_period DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT stock_abbr, total_profit FROM income_sheet WHERE report_year = '2023' ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 10;
